Step 1: 1339 is not a leap year (leap years divisible by 4, but 1339 not divisible by 4).  
Step 2: Days from 04-17 to end of 1339:  
April: 30 - 17 = 13 days left in April.  
May: 31, June: 30, July: 31, Aug: 31, Sep: 30, Oct: 31, Nov: 30, Dec: 31.  
Sum = 13 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 31 + 30 + 31 + 30 + 31 = 258 days left in 1339.  
Step 3: 298 total days – 258 days = 40 days into 1340.  
Step 4: 1340 is a leap year (divisible by 4). Jan 1340 has 31 days, so 40 – 31 = 9 days into February.  
Date: 1340-02-09.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1340-02-09
